note: Prefer querying data sources in VIEW mode - it is unmetered on the free Notion plan. SQL mode is billed.
dependencies: 'Blocked by' is a RELATION (pass page URLs, not story IDs). 'Blocked by IDs' and 'Blocker status' are rollups - they render in Notion's UI but return opaque handles to the API, so resolve blockers by fetching the linked pages. Status=Ready already means unblocked.
viewContract: Every project has its own 'road' view, filtered to that project and nothing else. Commands MUST scope by views.road - never by a shared browse view, whose filters anyone can change in the Notion UI.

git.notes: Standing warnings for THIS repo that stay true between sessions: where live credentials sit in the working tree, which workflows are path-filtered, which runners are expensive. Anything about the current working tree goes stale within the session and belongs in a story's Last session field instead.

notice: Optional. Shown at the top of every session. Keep anything private - spend figures, account state - in launch-control.local.json instead, which is gitignored.
